title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 171 (Members' right to inspect)

content.overview: Section 171 provides that the register kept under section 170 shall be open for inspection during business hours and the members shall have a right to take extracts therefrom and copies thereof, on payment of such fees as may be prescribed. The register shall also be produced at the commencement of every annual general meeting and shall remain open and accessible during the continuance of the meeting to any person having the right to attend the meeting.
content.glance: Members may inspect the s. 170 register during business hours and take extracts/copies on payment of prescribed fee; register must be open at the AGM to persons entitled to attend.
content.study: The register kept under section 170 shall be open for inspection during business hours and the members shall have a right to take extracts therefrom and copies thereof, on payment of such fees as may be prescribed. The register shall also be produced at the commencement of every annual general meeting of the company and shall remain open and accessible during the continuance of the meeting to any person having the right to attend the meeting. If any inspection or extract or copy is refused, the company and every officer of the company who is in default are liable to the penalty provided, and the Central Government or Tribunal may by order compel an immediate inspection. Current-law framing: confirm member status or AGM attendee right; demand inspection or extract; apply penalty and compulsion on refusal.

sections.heading: Inspection During Business Hours
sections.body: The s. 170 register is open to inspection by members during business hours.

sections.heading: Extracts and Copies
sections.body: Members may take extracts and copies on payment of the prescribed fee.

sections.heading: AGM Production
sections.body: The register must be produced at the start of every AGM and remain open to persons entitled to attend.

sections.heading: Refusal
sections.body: Refusal attracts penalty; Central Government or Tribunal may compel immediate inspection.

examples.title: Member inspection
examples.body: A member requests inspection of the directors' register during business hours. Under s. 171 the company must allow inspection.

examples.title: Refusal at AGM
examples.body: The company fails to produce the register at the AGM. Section 171 is breached and the residual or section-specific penalty and compulsion remedies apply.

hypotheticals.question: Does a non-member of the public have a right under s. 171 to inspect the company's internal register?
hypotheticals.analysis: Section 171 confers the inspection and extract rights on members (and AGM access on persons entitled to attend the meeting). Public search of ROC filings is a separate channel and is not the s. 171 right.

distinctions.title: Members' right to inspect (s. 171) vs register duty (s. 170)
distinctions.left: Access rights of members and AGM attendees
distinctions.right: Company's duty to maintain the register and file returns

misconceptions.trap: Only the AGM is the occasion for inspecting the directors' register.
misconceptions.correction: Members may inspect during business hours throughout the year; the AGM production is an additional obligation.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 171 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Confirm member or AGM attendee status. II. Identify inspection or extract demand. III. Apply refusal consequences. IV. Conclude.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should submissions contain?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Membership facts; demand; refusal if any; precise relief.

enhancement.definition: Section 171 gives members the right to inspect the s. 170 register during business hours and to take extracts or copies on payment of the prescribed fee, and requires the register to be open at the AGM.
enhancement.legalPrinciple: Members are entitled to transparency regarding who manages the company and what securities those managers hold.
essentialIngredients: Open to members during business hours
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 171 is the access companion to the maintenance duty in s. 170.
